description: Geocode both ways with Geokeo - turn an address or place name into coordinates and components, and turn coordinates back into the places nearest them, from OpenStreetMap data.

api.description: Turn an address or place name into coordinates, a formatted address and its components, with the OpenStreetMap class and type of the match

fields.description: What to look up, up to 50 characters, such as `empire state building`
Restricts the search to one country, such as `us` or `de`
Response format; only `json`, which is also the default

api.description: Turn a latitude and longitude into the places nearest it, each with its address, its components and how far away it is
